title: Yara and the Room
author: Felix Joubert
blurb: Theo Kavanagh, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
